user.title: ODD Invest
user.description: Address of the oddinvestd service and MQTT topic prefix (must match ODDINVEST_MQTT_PREFIX). Token only if the service is password-protected; get it in the app. Portfolio — only for a non-main one: the same slug as at the end of the prefix.

data.token: REST token — «Settings → Remote access» in the app
data.portfolio: Portfolio (slug) — empty for the main one

reconfigure.title: ODD Invest
reconfigure.description: Same fields as on setup. The prefix cannot change — it is the entry key.

data.token: REST token — «Settings → Remote access» in the app
data.portfolio: Portfolio (slug) — empty for the main one

error.invalid_auth: oddinvestd is password-protected and rejects this token (ODDINVEST_AUTH_TOKEN)
error.bad_contract: Service responded but the state document violates the contract (version mismatch?)
error.unknown_portfolio: The service has no portfolio with this slug
error.prefix_mismatch: The MQTT prefix does not match the portfolio: for a portfolio slug it must end with "/<slug>", which is how the service publishes satellites

abort.unique_id_mismatch: Prefix does not match the existing entry

init.title: ODD Invest notifications
init.description: The integration sends notifications itself to a chosen notify service — no manual automations.

data.notify_card_due: Card statement date (7, 3, 1 days ahead and on the day)

card_bring_by_due_uah.name: Bring to cards by due date

refresh.name: Refresh data
refresh.description: Refresh the NBU directory and FX rate on the service side, republish state.

config_entry_id.name: Portfolio
config_entry_id.description: Integration entry. Empty — the only one; required when there are several.

mark_payment.name: Mark payment
mark_payment.description: Mark a payout as received, or clear the mark.

config_entry_id.name: Portfolio
config_entry_id.description: Integration entry. Empty — the only one; required when there are several.

status.name: Status
status.description: received — money arrived; none — clear the mark.

unsupported_schema.title: Service and integration speak different contract versions
unsupported_schema.description: oddinvestd sends state document version {got}, but this integration understands {want}. Sensors are frozen at their last value. Update whichever side is behind — the integration via HACS or the service — and this issue clears itself with the first understood document.
